hook: AI just designed an entire CPU by itself.
hookText: AI just designed a whole CPU

beats.say: Architect Labs calls it Frostbite: a general-purpose processor with a brand-new instruction set, discovered, designed and verified end to end by their AI systems.
Across 25 workloads, 15 of them held back until the final test, it delivered 4.59 times the performance per watt of a modern, silicon-proven CPU core.
A swarm of agents tried 58 design ideas and kept 37, using a chip simulator that runs 660 times faster than the real hardware model.
